array.string: export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.fsmonitor GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=false; C=__PICKUP_REPO__; G="$C/.git"; page() { echo "[launchd] $(date -u +%FT%TZ) $1" >&2; E="$(dirname "$C")/.env"; U="$(sed -n 's/^PUSHOVER_USER=//p' "$E" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | tr -d "\"'")"; K="$(sed -n 's/^PUSHOVER_TOKEN=//p' "$E" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | tr -d "\"'")"; [ -n "$U" ] && [ -n "$K" ] && /usr/bin/curl -fsS -m 10 --form-string "token=$K" --form-string "user=$U" --form-string "title=radon grok-fix-pickup: pickup did not start" --form-string "message=$1" https://api.pushover.net/1/messages.json >/dev/null 2>&1; return 0; }; { T="$(command -v timeout || command -v gtimeout || true)"; [ -n "$T" ] || { page "no timeout or gtimeout on PATH; install coreutils"; exit 78; }; rm -f "$G/index.lock" "$G/HEAD.lock"; find "$G" \( -path "$G/objects" -o -path "$G/worktrees" \) -prune -o -type f -name "*.lock" -mmin +10 -exec rm -f {} + 2>/dev/null; F=1; for i in 1 2 3; do "$T" -k 15 180 git -C "$C" -c core.sshCommand="ssh -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=4" fetch -q origin && { F=0; break; }; [ "$i" = 3 ] || sleep "${RADON_LAUNCHD_FETCH_PAUSE_SECS:-30}"; done; [ "$F" = 0 ] && git -C "$C" checkout -f -q main && git -C "$C" reset --hard -q origin/main; } || { page "refresh of $C failed (fetch, checkout or reset); this cycle did not run"; exit 70; }; exec /usr/bin/env python3.13 __PICKUP_REPO__/scripts/grok_fix_pickup.py --repo __PICKUP_REPO__
